summary: Batch processing loop that walks three arrays of physics records on the per-frame tick. Pass one iterates the count stored at this+8 over the array base this+0xC with byte stride 48, calling F_3x3MatrixVectorMultiply on every element. Pass two iterates the count at this+16 over the array base this+0x14 with byte stride 48, calling F_3x3MatrixInverseCoordinateTransform. Pass three iterates the count at this+24 over the array base this+0x1C with byte stride 72, calling sub_56D2D0 on every element and re-reading the count each iteration. Returns the last-read third-pass count.

local_names.this: batch descriptor holding three count/pointer pairs
local_names.v3: pass-one byte offset into the array at this+0xC
local_names.v5: pass-two byte offset into the array at this+0x14
local_names.v8: pass-three byte offset into the array at this+0x1C
local_names.result: third-pass count re-read from this+24 each iteration and returned

operations.description: First pass entered only when the count this+8 (this[2]) is greater than 0
First pass iterates count this+8 elements of the array at base this+0xC (this[3]) with byte stride 48
Per-element 3x3 matrix-vector multiply F_3x3MatrixVectorMultiply on each record
Second pass entered only when the count this+16 (this[4]) is greater than 0
Second pass iterates count this+16 elements of the array at base this+0x14 (this[5]) with byte stride 48
Per-element 3x3 inverse coordinate transform F_3x3MatrixInverseCoordinateTransform on each record
Third pass iterates count this+24 elements of the array at base this+0x1C (this[7]) with byte stride 72, re-reading the count from this+24 at every iteration
Per-element constraint solve step sub_56D2D0 on each record
